PockPock Agent 0.2.5 fixes 41 problems found in testing: agent runs that failed, hung or reported success they had not earned, two security gaps, and many smaller rough edges.

## Download

| Your computer | Download |
|---|---|
| Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit) | [PockPock-Agent-Setup.exe](https://github.com/PockPock9/PockPockAgent/releases/latest/download/PockPock-Agent-Setup.exe) |
| Mac with Apple silicon (M1 or newer) | [PockPock-Agent-mac-arm64.dmg](https://github.com/PockPock9/PockPockAgent/releases/latest/download/PockPock-Agent-mac-arm64.dmg) |
| Mac with an Intel processor | [PockPock-Agent-mac-x64.dmg](https://github.com/PockPock9/PockPockAgent/releases/latest/download/PockPock-Agent-mac-x64.dmg) |

**Already using 0.2.4 on Windows?** PockPock updates itself: press **Restart to update** when it appears, or check in **Settings → Updates**. On a Mac, download and install it once, the same way as the first time. Your chats, settings and models are kept.

**New to PockPock?** Open the downloaded file, then press **Set up PockPock**; setup installs everything else. Windows may show **"Windows protected your PC"** because PockPock is not code-signed yet: press **More info**, then **Run anyway**. On a Mac, see the [installation guide](https://github.com/PockPock9/PockPockAgent/wiki/Installation).

## What's new since 0.2.4

### Security
- The Files panel no longer follows a shortcut (symbolic link or junction) out of the open folder.
- The local services no longer publish their API description at `/openapi.json`.
- A build dependency (`minimatch`) is updated to a version without a known vulnerability.

### Agent runs
- A task that only needs to save a file no longer fails with "did not invoke a task tool": the agent now always gets the tools to save it.
- A run waiting for your approval no longer stays "running" forever if the app is closed, and **Stop** ends it.
- A success check is no longer reported as passed when the browser or search that would prove it failed.
- Saving the file you asked for completes the task, even when the request also reads like a code change.
- An image task without an image fails and says which local image engine to start, instead of reporting success.
- Research with no reachable source stops at once and says so, instead of retrying twice.

### Skills, MCP servers and OpenClaw
- **New:** add an MCP server that is already on your computer by typing the command that starts it, for example `python3 server.py`, on the MCP servers page.
- A skill whose `SKILL.md` has no name or description now works: PockPock adds the header OpenClaw needs.
- A repository holding several MCP servers (such as `modelcontextprotocol/servers`) lists them so you can pick one.
- **New:** **Settings → Slow local models in OpenClaw → Allow slow models** lets a small model on a computer without a graphics card finish its first answer, and the timeout error now gives the correct fix.

### Smaller fixes
- Run history stays in your own data folder, even if a PockPock service from another folder was still running.
- Algorithm questions ("time complexity of binary search") go to the coding model.
- Memory also remembers the language you want replies in, and tells you when it could not keep something you asked it to remember.
- **Task folder** opens the folder where the run saved its files.
- A problem report needs a short description.
- Setup tries the browser and model downloads again when one fails on a slow connection.
- Clearer errors: empty messages, unknown runs and approvals, a browser that cannot start, NemoClaw messages on Linux.

## Good to know

- These fixes are covered by automated tests; most were not tried in a full agent run with a real model.
- The run-history fix addresses the most likely cause of history disappearing after a restart; the original report could not be reproduced here.
- Help, screenshots and example prompts are in the [wiki](https://github.com/PockPock9/PockPockAgent/wiki).
- Please [report problems](https://github.com/PockPock9/PockPockAgent/issues/new/choose).
